description: This file defines a generic internal sealed class DurableState<T> implementing IPersistentState<T> and IDurableStateMachine, managing durable state with serialization, versioning, and state application logic within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: DurableState<T>
classes.description: A sealed internal class managing durable state with versioning, serialization, and application logic, supporting persistence and state application within Orleans.

methods.name: DurableState
methods.description: Constructor initializing durable state with dependencies and registering state machine.

methods.name: OnWriteCompleted
methods.description: Increments version and invokes OnPersisted callback after a write.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the state value to default.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a log entry to update the state, handling versioning and command types.

methods.name: AppendEntries
methods.description: Appends log entries by writing state.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to create a deep copy of the state.

methods.name: WriteState
methods.description: Serializes and writes the current state to a writer.
